title: GHO-ECO
tagline: GHO-ECO a platform where we connect blockchain and sustainability. Organizations showcase their eco-friendly packaging and products. The best ones get rewarded with GHO tokens. Join us on a journey towards a greener future. Let's Gho Eco !
description:
We at GHO-ECO Invite all the organizations to showcase their eco friendly initiatives. Let it be the product or the packaging or anything which contributes to the environment. They can showcase it for free on our platform. Also, The best ones will be getting GHO tokens as a reward. This is a 3 step process. 1) The Organizations upload the details and image of their eco friendly products. 2) the judges then see the entries on their dashboard. 3) The judges reward the best entries.

Future Scope :- I want to implement a voting based system on the judges page, where the entries will be sorted on the basis of number of votes and ranked on top of the page respectively. Also, charging the organizations for participating could be the potential business model, and the organizations would happily pay the participation charge as they are getting free advertisement on the featured page.

( Note :- Please use Chrome browser for testing the demo link. The images on the featured page don't load in Brave Browser for some reason )
how_its_made: I've crafted an impressive tech setup for my web app, using React.js on the frontend, Solidity in the backend, and spicing things up with framer motion and gsap for custom cursor and animations. To seamlessly connect users to my DApp, I've used ConnectKit making the wallet integration seamless. The choice of using ConnectKit is a game-changer, saving me from writing an extra 15-20 lines of code for wallet connections. This not only streamlines development but also boosts the overall efficiency of my DApp. For handling interactions with my smart contract, I opted for Wagmi 1.x. This has been a game-changer, simplifying the process of engaging with the smart contract. It's a time-saver and has streamlined the development workflow, allowing me to manage interactions with the smart contract more efficiently. Choosing Wagmi 1.x was definitely a wise decision in enhancing the functionality of my DApp. To make it more efficient, The Images are stored on the IPFS network and the hash of the image is stored on the blockchain. while retrieving the data from the blockchain, the image with the respective hash is fetched from IPFS and rendered on the featured and judges page.
